intro: In Stormwind, Gakin the Darkbinder seeks the choker he gave his former apprentice, Surena Caledon. After Surena fled to join the Defias Brotherhood, Gakin sent aspiring acolytes to take it back by force.

p: Gakin the Darkbinder works quietly beneath the Slaughtered Lamb in Stormwind, where he took Surena Caledon on as a promising student of the dark arts. Drawn to her youthful charm and magical aptitude, he gave her a valuable bloodstone choker to aid her studies. Surena abandoned her training and fled with Erlan Drudgemoor, a rogue aligned with the Defias Brotherhood. Gakin will not leave a potent artifact in a traitor’s hands. He sends initiates seeking mastery over the void to find Surena at the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch and reclaim the necklace by force. Their deed will show where true loyalty lies.
